snapshot.what_it_does: Sun Pharma is a global pharmaceutical company with a diversified presence across innovative medicines, branded generics, generics and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), serving patients in more than 100 countries. It also has a consumer healthcare business and focuses on specialty segments of dermatology, ophthalmology and onco-dermatology.

segments.name: India Formulations
segments.note: FY26 revenue ₹193 Billion, grew 14%; market share 8.4% (Pharmarack MAT March 2026); largest pharma company in India

segments.name: US
segments.note: FY26 revenue ₹168.2 Billion, up 3.6%; 13th largest generics company in the US; Innovative Medicines exceeded generics share of US sales for the first time

segments.name: Emerging Markets
segments.note: FY26 revenue ₹111,865 Million, grew 18.8%; presence in 80+ countries; 3,300+ sales reps; manufacturing in 9 markets

segments.name: Rest of World (RoW)
segments.note: FY26 revenue ₹85,684 Million, grew 19.6%; Western Europe, Canada, Israel, Japan, A&NZ

segments.name: Global Innovative Medicines
segments.note: 29 marketed products; reported separately but embedded in geographic segments; key products ILUMYA, ODOMZO, WINLEVI, CEQUA, LEQSELVI, UNLOXCYT

segments.name: API
segments.note: FY26 revenue ₹21,853 Million, up 2.6%; ~400 APIs; 13 manufacturing units; 409 DMF/CEP approvals

segments.name: Global Consumer Healthcare
segments.note: 25+ countries; top-10 consumer healthcare company in India, Romania, Nigeria, Myanmar; brands Revital, Volini, Prohance

snapshot.geographies: Serves 100+ countries; 80+ emerging markets with established operations; international markets contribute 66% of revenues and India 34%; manufacturing footprint of 40 facilities globally including in Bangladesh, South Africa, Malaysia, Romania, Egypt, Morocco, Nigeria and Russia.

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Management is largely credible: dated commitments—UNLOXCYT launch, ILUMYA sBLA, day-one India semaglutide, FY27 R&D guidance, margin normalization—were met as promised. The one clear miss is the ~27.8% tax-rate assurance, with Q2 FY27 ETR near 37%; FY27 revenue guidance and Organon closing remain open.

bull.point: FY26 revenue rose 11.9% to ₹584.6bn and EBITDA 16.1% to ₹177bn, with India +14%, Emerging Markets +18.8% and RoW +19.6%.
Innovative Medicines reached 22% of sales; in the US, innovative products exceeded generics for the first time, reducing pure-generic dependence.
Execution credibility is high: UNLOXCYT launch, ILUMYA sBLA filing, semaglutide day-one readiness and margin normalization were delivered.

bear.point: Q2 FY27 PAT fell 36.2% as ETR ran near 37% versus management’s ~27.8% assurance, a clear guidance miss.
US momentum is soft: FY26 US revenue grew only 3.6%, while US sales fell 1.1% in Q4 FY26 and 9.7% in Q1 FY27.
bear.cite: annual-reports/annual-report-2026.md; Q4 FY26 p5; Q1 FY27 p5

bear.point: Organon adds US$11.75bn enterprise-value scale and biosimilars entry, but closing remains pending and integration economics are not stated.

watch: Whether ETR moves back toward ~27.8% or stays near Q2 FY27’s ~37%.
Organon closing by early 2027/Q4 FY27 and any disclosed financing or synergy terms; none are stated.
US generics compliance/recovery versus continued innovative-mix gains; compliance status is not stated.
